name: contents-2026-12
description: First contents (page-reading) run: the default contents call of Exa, Context.dev, Firecrawl and TinyFish on the contents-urls-0.1.0 set (five strata of up to 60 URLs), three passes, seeded order, neutral pacing. Build the URL set after the full search runs have read their pages, so the pooled stratum can draw equally from all four providers.
